summary: Validate execution-model policy and confined adoption artifacts

delivery.outcome: Reject malformed catalog execution-model names/records, unknown levels and non-boolean effect flags before adoption checks. Reject drive/root-qualified or escaping managed-artifact targets before file hashing; preserve valid declarations and confined artifacts. Publish standard 0.20.76 after protected merge.
nonGoals: Authorize runtime effects or infer permission from catalog flags
Change pack identity, record levels, profile selection, workflow parsing or preflight caching
Add a bundled standard-pack module, runtime dependencies or change schema identity
Claim resistance to arbitrary same-user concurrent path mutations
Mutate foreign or frozen target state

architecture.decision: Validate each execution model in catalog_findings before any adoption policy consumes it. Require a nonempty name, object declaration, recognized string maximumLevel and actual boolean authorizesEffects; preserve exact names and valid metadata. Exercise actual strict JSON CLI and source validation through existing shell and native portable suites. Resolve managed-artifact targets under the canonical root after portable absolute/drive/parent-path checks, and reject escapes before is_file or hashing. Keep existing artifact finding codes and confined paths, including confined symlinks; no race-proof claim.
interfaceChanges: Existing standard-adoption conformance rejects malformed execution-model policy and unmanaged escaping artifact targets before data access.
architecture.rollback: Revert the material source fix through protected publication; preserve controller and review receipts.

validation.evidence: Actual strict CLI rejects malformed model objects, maximumLevel values and authorizesEffects types; all valid S0-S5 and boolean values and exact names remain accepted. Actual external symlink and drive-qualified declarations fail before hashing; ordinary confined files and in-root symlinks remain valid. Native Windows and POSIX path cases exercise the same validator.
Existing integration, wheel/parity, native and exact-head Linux/Windows/OneDev checks pass.
Independent protected merge and final standard v0.20.75 release verified.
